[SWS_SM_CONSTR_00001] Existence of State Management
⌈
At least
one
Modelled Process
with Process.functionClusterAffinity with the value
STATE_MANAGEMENT shall be configured to run in each MachineFG state ex-
cept Off, whenever one such
Modelled Process
is configured to run in MachineFG
state Startup.
